import copy, json
from work import evaluate
policy={'edges': {'a>b': {}, 'b>c': {'role': 'op'}}, 'retry_limit': 2}
cases=[
 ({'from':'a','to':'b'}, {'ok':True,'value':'b','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'x','to':'y'}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','retry':True,'attempts':99}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'c','reason':'ok'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':True}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
 ({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'op','retry':True,'attempts':-1}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
]
for req,want in cases:
 p0=copy.deepcopy(policy); r0=copy.deepcopy(req); got=evaluate(req,policy); assert got==want,(req,got,want); assert req==r0 and policy==p0
report=json.load(open('report.json')); requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); current=json.load(open('policy.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,current) for r in requests]
schema=json.load(open('OUTPUT_SCHEMA.json')); assert all(set(x)==set(schema['required']) and type(x['ok']) is bool and (x['value'] is None or type(x['value']) is str) and x['reason'] in schema['properties']['reason']['enum'] for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
